plan: dispatch://INFRA-692/artifact/plan-md (version 1). Base main 8b4a862b. Paths relative to packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/. Change 1: new pmdoc/valid_document.go ValidDocument (made only by ValidateDocument(doc, operation) = today's wantDocument, or by ReadUnshared) whose BlockPathsAndTableRows/TableRows/TableDescendantIDs/RenderWithBlockOffsets/token-encoding methods skip Validate; exported functions keep validating with today's messages (render keeps its own nil/non-doc messages and recoverPanic on both entries); docs buildDocumentRead/renderedBlocks/documentTokens take ValidDocument; documentBlocks validates once via ValidateDocument(tree, "TableRows"); encodedTokens(*Node) stays for checkEditPrecondition, sharing one hashing helper. Change 2: pmdoc.ReadUnshared(frag) (ValidDocument, error) for the fold's private decoded document: same tree walker, text read by a literal port of ygo ToDelta's loop that emits text nodes directly (rules 1-6 in plan.md: interface-nil format deletes, DeepEqual run comparison at attrsDirty boundaries, empty strings clear attrsDirty and make no node, string embeds are their own unmerged node with live attrs, other embeds refused with 'unsupported yjs text embed %T', other content ignored, ownedValue copies kept, fresh string per run); one shared once-resolved type-checked helper for ygo's private 'start' field replaces update.go:538 yTextStart; foldDocument's post-load work becomes one function the corpus test calls, ReadUnshared errors through documentSchemaError. Change 3: INFRA-649 cleanups: the token encoder allocates its own buffer (no dst prefix, no undo-on-error; renamed since it no longer appends), validated and ValidDocument (unvalidated) entries share it; nodeMarks' one-mark branch goes; prefix loop in token_test.go goes; AGENTS.md:394 renamed. Tests: TestReadUnsharedReadsWhatReadReads (corpus, fixtures, browser-like ygo edits, crafted updates) and FuzzReadUnshared (oracle: error text + ErrSchema class, canonical tree dumps with marks sorted by dump), ReadUnshared added to nesting_test depth-bound table, api schema_repair route test pinned to exact messages + block-path route + pmdoc malformed trees + an accepted string embed (same file run at base), TestTokenCorpus reads through the fold function with unchanged dump format. Scope: fold only; GetAttributeValues and ygo unchanged (measured: sizing ygo's map removes nothing); ownedValue copy kept; checkEditPrecondition unchanged.

findings.finding: The base-vs-head corpus run never exercises the new reader, and changing buildDocumentRead's signature breaks the shared file at base.
findings.answer: Base runs main's own committed token_corpus_test.go; head's copy reads through the extracted fold function (ReadUnshared + ValidDocument build) with the dump format unchanged, so cmp compares the fold's real code with base. Edit histories are covered by tests 1-2 and the seed's server-anchored comments, stated in A6.

findings.finding: Matching ToDelta exactly has traps (string embeds are accepted today, empty strings affect merging, typed nil, DeepEqual/NaN, ignored content types, error order); the prototype refused every embed.
findings.answer: Plan Change 2 ports ToDelta's loop literally and lists rules 1-6; test 1 and FuzzReadUnshared cover each with ygo operations and crafted updates; oracle is error text + class and canonical dumps with marks sorted by dump; two non-object marks on one run only need to fail on both sides.

findings.finding: Skipping ownedValue is unmeasured, breaks the written no-sharing promise and rests on an unstated LoadDocument ownership contract.
findings.answer: Dropped: ReadUnshared keeps ownedValue copies, so pmdoc/read.go:9-10 and packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:562-567 hold; the skip (~0.25 s of a 10-spec pass) is named to the architect, not done.

findings.finding: The spec's GetAttributeValues step is left out.
findings.answer: Measured: ygo's map sized by len(itemMap) gives 2,544,868 vs 2,544,867 allocations and 0.28 s vs 0.29-0.32 s per pass, i.e. nothing; a Dispatch-side reflective read builds the same one map. Brought to the architect in the completion summary and the PR body (A3); no ygo change.

findings.finding: The merge rule needs a named measured function and an expected gain fixed before the runs; ToDelta alone would fall to zero by renaming.
findings.answer: A4 names the fold share (foldDocument minus LoadDocument and GC, INFRA-649's measure) with E = base fold share x r, r from the whole-corpus timing of the fold function, preliminary r ~ 0.14; notes the denominator effect, the newer comment's 'either clause unless contradicted', and the load-test commit to record.

findings.finding: Routing checkEditPrecondition through the wrapper saves nothing and risks its refusal order and non-doc behaviour.
findings.answer: checkEditPrecondition is unchanged; encodedTokens(*Node) stays for it, sharing only the hashing helper.

findings.finding: The wrapper's constructor must not change any exported refusal; zero value undefined; ReadUnshared errors must stay documentSchemaError.
findings.answer: ValidateDocument(doc, operation) is today's wantDocument with the caller's operation name; render keeps its own messages and recoverPanic; zero ValidDocument methods return the exported counterpart's nil-tree error; tree immutability is the type's documented contract; ReadUnshared's error goes through documentSchemaError as treeOf's does.

findings.finding: 'Every path' covers more routes than the route test (block path, block index, reference excerpts) and the test checks only Contains.
findings.answer: Test 4 pins exact messages, adds GET /blocks/{block_id}, pmdoc's malformed trees (mark on non-text, unknown mark, depth and nesting bounds, non-object mark value) and an accepted string embed, and runs at base too; block index and excerpts branch on errors.Is(ErrDocOutsideSchema), covered by the exact text and class of TextWithBlocks' errors. ReadUnshared joins nesting_test's depth-bound table.

findings.finding: 'Byte-identical on every LINUX spec' has a literal and a precedent reading; corpus snapshot unnamed.
findings.answer: A6 states the reading: (a) fresh fetch of every LINUX spec through the fold, cmp of the dump (doc token, markdown SHA-256, every block's range, token, descendants, rows), (b) HTTP diff of /text, /blocks and block paths on the seeded stack; the limit (no real edit histories in the corpus) is stated in the PR.

findings.finding: The unsafe offset fails silently if ygo renames the field.
findings.answer: One helper resolves the field once, checks it exists with type *crdt.Item, panics naming it otherwise, and replaces update.go:538 yTextStart for both walks.

findings.finding: A third text reader can drift from ToDelta.
findings.answer: Test 1 compares ReadUnshared with Read, which keeps ToDelta, on every CI run, so a ygo upgrade that changes ToDelta fails it.

findings.finding: 'How treeOf asks ygo' could mean every treeOf caller.
findings.answer: Fold only, with the reason (measured cost is under foldDocument; other readers run on replicas, forks and transactions with other locking).

findings.answer: Order step 5 and integration name each; dispatch-memory is in A7.
